"""Reconstruct identical actual pair units and replay the inherited independent masks."""
from collections import defaultdict
from pathlib import Path
import numpy as np
from train_directional_bank_trial import guard,read,ref,save
from train_v43_quality_trial import live
from demosaic.prediction_archive import fingerprint
repo=Path('/home/dllu/proj/demosaic');root=repo/'.cache/quality-20261107/V166-common-support-routing-v2'
plan=read(root/'plan-v1.json');guard(plan);previous=Path(plan['previous']);status=read(root/'status-v1.json')
assert status['status']=='completed-matched-training-awaiting-fixed-quality-review' and not live(status['owner'])
prior=read(previous/'plan-v1.json');assert plan['cache']==prior['cache']
assert ref(Path(plan['work'])/'scripts/flat_target_anchor.py')['sha256']==ref(Path(prior['work'])/'scripts/flat_target_anchor.py')['sha256']
relay=read(previous/'training-unit-audit-v1.json');oracle_binding=relay['independent_V162_mask_oracle']
assert ref(oracle_binding['path'])==oracle_binding;oracle=read(oracle_binding['path'])
assert oracle['mask_arrays_checked']==1000 and oracle['cache']==plan['cache']
cache=read(plan['cache']['path']);training=read(root/'train-result-v1.json');old=read(previous/'train-result-v1.json')
assert len(training['trace'])==len(old['trace'])==len(cache['batches'])==1000
records=[];pairs=supervised=0;group_values=defaultdict(list)
for row,before,item,mask in zip(training['trace'],old['trace'],cache['batches'],oracle['rows'],strict=True):
 assert all(row[k]==before[k] for k in ['step','batch','domain','flat_target_mask']) and row['batch']==item['arrays']
 for field in ['values','eligible_pixels','total_pixels','per_image_eligible_pixels']:assert row['flat_target_mask'][field]==mask[field]
 variance=np.asarray(item['metadata']['sensor'].get('increment_mean_variance',[]),dtype=np.float32)
 raw=np.sqrt(variance);value=np.maximum(raw,np.float32(2/65535)).reshape(-1,1,1,1)
 for arm in ['common-control','routed-common']:
  assert fingerprint(value)==row['arms'][arm]['pair_unit_values'] and row['arms'][arm]['pair_unit_floor_DN16']==2
 assert fingerprint(np.maximum(raw,np.float32(16/65535)).reshape(-1,1,1,1))==item['inputs']['pair_units']
 adc=item['metadata']['noise']['shot']==item['metadata']['noise']['read']==0
 if adc:assert all(a['loss']==a['gradient_norm']==0 for a in row['arms'].values())
 pairs+=len(raw);supervised+=0 if adc else len(raw)
 if len(raw):group_values[row['domain'],adc].extend(value.ravel().tolist())
 records.append({'step':row['step'],'domain':row['domain'],'ADC_only':adc,'pairs':len(raw),
  'mean_increment_variance_FP32':variance.tolist(),'control_units_FP32':value.ravel().tolist(),
  'candidate_units_FP32':value.ravel().tolist(),'mask':row['flat_target_mask']})
assert (pairs,supervised)==(1382,1240)
groups=[{'domain':domain,'ADC_only':adc,'pairs':len(values),'unit_DN16_median_p90_max':np.quantile(np.array(values,dtype=np.float64)*65535,[.5,.9,1]).tolist(),
 'common_error_unit_DN16':16,'common_error_total_weight':0 if adc else 1} for (domain,adc),values in group_values.items()]
assert len(groups)==6
output=root/'training-unit-audit-v1.json';assert not output.exists()
save(output,{'status':'pass-all1000-independent-identical-unit-checks-and-inherited-mask-oracle',
 'training':ref(root/'train-result-v1.json'),'baseline_training':ref(previous/'train-result-v1.json'),'independent_V162_mask_oracle':oracle_binding,
 'inherited_mask_replay':ref(previous/'training-unit-audit-v1.json'),'unchanged_mask_source':ref(Path(plan['work'])/'scripts/flat_target_anchor.py'),
 'same_cache':plan['cache'],'independent_unit_records':1000,'actual_unit_fingerprints_checked':2000,'inherited_mask_records_matched':1000,
 'pairs':pairs,'supervised_pairs':supervised,'supervised_pairs_changed':0,'rows':records,'unit_groups':groups,'new_independent_mask_computations':0,
 'source':dict(ref(Path(__file__)),text=Path(__file__).read_text()),'new_forwards':0,'new_noise_draws':0,
 'scope':'Both actual arms use identical floor2DN16 units. Independent NumPy FP32 reconstruction from retained pre-ADC mean increment variances verifies all1000 actual records/2000 fingerprints,and reconstructs original16DN16 cached arrays separately. Domain/ADC quantiles independently aggregate actual values. All1000 actual masks replay the already independent V162 oracle via identical targets and unchanged mask source through V165;no new independent mask calculation. No inference-flatness/confidence/quality guarantee.'})
print('PASS1000 actual identical unit records/2000 fingerprints/1000 inherited audited masks;1240 supervised pair units unchanged')
